about_the_game:
“The Broken Clock” plunges you into a vibrant fantasy world where intrigue and adventure await around every corner. With a dynamic Active Time Battle (ATB) turn‑based combat system, each encounter becomes a test of strategy and speed: manage your actions, seize your allies’ turns, and unleash unique powers at precisely the right moment.

An Epic Universe

Traverse varied landscapes—from treasure‑strewn deserts and flooded forests to the ruins of an ancient civilization, brimming with traps and forgotten relics; through chaotic realms where the laws of nature shift without warning and reality itself fractures; to active volcanoes whose fire and lava demand total endurance.

Unforgettable Heroes

Join Ray and his friends—each with their own distinct personality—on their journey to save Arzelia. Forge bonds, uncover secrets of their pasts, and strengthen camaraderie as you progress through the story.

Challenges for Every Taste

  • Formidable Bosses: Face titanic creatures and magic‑wielding foes designed to test your reflexes and wit.

  • Puzzles: Solve ancient mechanisms and unlock new paths by discovering hidden passages.

  • Optional Dungeons: Explore secret dungeons and earn special rewards for uncovering their mysteries.

Class System

Choose from 22 distinct classes, each offering unique abilities and playstyles. From warriors specialized in melee combat to mages who command the elements, customize your party to meet every challenge.

Retro Inspiration with a Modern Twist

Inspired by classics such as Final Fantasy, Golden Sun, and Chrono Trigger, “The Broken Clock” captures the magic of bygone JRPGs—charismatic characters, an epic soundtrack, and immersive storytelling—while adding fresh exploration and puzzle‑solving mechanics for a varied and revitalized experience.

short_description: A Japanese fantasy role-playing game in the pure style of the SNES classics. Join Ray, Eliza, Lera and Nets in an exciting adventure where human ingenuity and obsession cause all kinds of problems that they will have to fight to save their world.
